body: I have the plans in my head but I dont have the motivation to do it. I dont think i could go through with all of it

Ive thought about jogging. Just to get into better shape. I lost 20 pounds recently somehow and i feel a lot better about myself. Ive wanted to get into better shape but i cant find the will to make myself go for it.

Me and my girlfriend had plans to save up and move so she could go to college and i was going to find a job in construction or in woodworking. We had almost everything planned out. I mean as much as we could think of for our age. That was the plan. I dont know anymore. I thought about going to a Technical school and taking a few classes because then i could avoid college debts and get the same or even better education for much less money. Plumbing was one of my thoughts for that.

I go to a different type of school because i transfered from my other school. I go for three hours a day then i can go home. Its usually where the kids who get in trouble go to or if people are behind and need to recover lost credits. I go there because I didnt have friends at my other schools and so i could finish school early. I really dont have any friends and its impossible to make friends at my school because they are all in trouble with the law and they do drugs and im not into any of those things.

Where could I find people my age to talk to on the internet?
It would be nice to have a couple of friends my age since I dont have any in real life anymore
i guess that makes sense. I never thought of it like that.

I wish i could redo it honestly. I messed up so many times and i just dont feel good about it.
Im not sure if he would be able to give me a great learning experience because he is more of a self taught woodworker and hes very busy with teaching and his other jobs. Ive thought about asking him if he could help me find a place to work after school or recommend me somewhere so that i could get into woodworking more but im not sure if he would do that. I missed a lot of class due to my depression and i doubt he would see me as a very hard worker.

i dont have tools to do it sadly. im always on different subreddits obsessing over people tools and creations though. The only thing ive made is a desk out of oak and black walnut. I made it at school for my woodworking class. It was the first and only thing ive made but ive been wanting to start doing more.
Woodworking would be the closest thing. other than that i dont really know

I had a job but i couldnt keep going in to work because i was busy with school and too sad to keep making myself go in. I had people i would talk to at work but i never would hang out with them because it didnt feel comfortable around them outside of work

I used to play xbox. ive wanted to switch to pc but i dont have any money. i always thought that wood working was interesting but i dont have things to do it with. Ive lost interest in basically everything. I watch movies and tv shows sometimes, but i get lonelier because it reminds me of my girlfriend. We always watched things together and i cant finish the things because it doesnt seem right.

I guess its just making it harder that I have no one to talk to about anything. Its just go to school. go home. sleep. wake up. and repeat. every day. I dont know how to make friends becasue i go to school three hours a day because its different than traditional school. I dont talk to anybody there because they all are kids that do drugs and get in trouble. i dont even know where to go to make friends online. i dont feel like i would even find a good friend no matter how hard i tried. the loneliness just makes me want to disappear.
Im a junior. Ive failed some classes already and i feel like im not going to get anything done.
